author: CakeAsylum
body: OK. I'm definitely sure you get this a lot. But, the reason I got ban evaded was because of my brother.<br id="null"><br id="null">I'll understand if you don't accept this, because in all honesty, I can't prove this. I can, however, tell you in all my truthfulness, that this wasn't me. Now let me explain what happened.<br id="null"><br id="null">I have a brother, he's in college, and he didn't really want his account anymore (Kahoolawe), so he decided to go hacking. I didn't think he'd actually do it, or go on any servers that I actually cared about. Then, when he went on Avicus, I told him that wouldn't be a good idea. He, of course, ignored me. He was doing the most blatant stuff ever. Right then, I was scared for my account, because we have the same IP at the time, because he's back from college. So then he logs into my account when I'm not there. He starts saying stuff about the other account. AND HE STARTS HACKING ON MINE! I'm still really mad at him. Like why would he do this?<br id="null"><br id="null">The problem about this appeal is that you just have to take my word for it. That's the problem. And I SWEAR that none of this will EVER happen again. I've become to like Avicus, and made some pretty cool friends while playing on it! I really don't want to lose that. <br id="null"><br id="null">So, please, just believe me. I will understand if you can't, but I really, truly, want to get back what I had before.<br id="null"><br id="null">Thank you, <br id="null">CakeAsylum<br id="null">

title: CakeAsylum Appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello CakeAsylum,

Your account is your responsibility, it's not our fault your brother hacked into your account and got himself banned. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
